decision_rule: A case is FLAGGED iff at least one agent's LATEST submit_assessment verdict is 'fault_suspected' (every assessment cites >= 1 measurement event). If no agent filed an assessment the case is NOT flagged and is reported as decision_missing. The deterministic baseline flags a case iff any pre-registered rule triggers (PairedBaselineConfig).
note: Deterministic rule baseline on all 12 cases of p7-paired-v1 (no model calls).
